summary: Containerized AAP services are user systemd units; check and control them with `systemctl --user status|start|stop <service>`.
questions: How do I restart a containerized AAP service?
How do I check the status of automation-gateway-proxy?
Are containerized AAP services managed by systemd?

answer_card.title: Control services
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
systemctl --user status automation-gateway-proxy
systemctl --user restart automation-controller-task
```
Units live in `~/.config/systemd/user/`.
